svg.text: checked in the code at build 1c0c853

text.tspan: Six claw machines. Each one is stuffed with 8
different cuties you can collect — 48 in all.
Win 3 from a machine and the third one arrives
holding a golden key that opens the next
machine, and the arcade throws you a parade.
The whole arcade is one index.html. Every
plushie is drawn with shapes in code. Every
sound is made by the computer as it plays.
Nothing is downloaded, nothing is installed.
That is why it starts instantly.
Three things decide a grab: how centred you
were, how buried the cutie was, and the
machine’s grip. Nothing is faked and nothing
is rigged. A miss still shoves the pile, so

svg.text: The six machines that exist right now
Made for Ella — Creator, Owner & Game Boss
